title: Strict Roos model and canonical data
statement: For normalized reindexing data D and a completed tensor reindexing T satisfying the forward generator and strict-tower naturality laws, the strict Roos Model equation and the Canonical equation both hold.

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; strict Roos realization before Canonical.

proof.text: Choose simultaneous flat-term K-flat representatives; identify finite tensor reductions by the generator law, use tower naturality for coherent transitions, and transport the equality through the specified Roos coordinates and localization.

lean.statement: theorem podReindexingTensorRoosNormalization_model_iff_canonical {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g] [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)] [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D) (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D) (hgen : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Generators l E g D T) (hnat : PodCompletedTensorReindex.TowerNaturality l E g D T) : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Model l E g D T ∧ PodCompletedTensorReindex.Canonical l E g D T
